author: Dyspa
body:
To start with, I don't have anything against Pop besides his immaturity.
I've heard Pop making fun of spanish people almost everyday in TS and this is getting annoying so the thing is, I was talking in a chat I can't remember right now, and I got poked by Deadmok3 regarding a trouble he was having, he told me (In spanish) that people were getting into the spanish room to make fun of them and he didn't like this at all as he and his friends were organizing a team for the tourney, I didn't say anything more than: "If you're in the spanish chat and you're spanish, the priority is yours".
A couple of minutes later Pop and someone else came in their room and started playing music (Very loud) with them in the chat, they got really annoyed and switched chats, minutes later, I got into their chat and they said they were done with the people disturbing them. They were really frustrated.

I felt bad for them so that's the reason of me making this report.
Thanks!
